rationale: Game020 showModal places its native dialog in the browser top layer and makes ordinary document content inert. The unchanged shared consent panel is document Shadow DOM with z-index10000; a z-index cannot put it above that top layer. Initial reject/defer choices are therefore inaccessible while the title is open. The local nonmodal dialog removes that conflict while board state/inert/disabled guards must still be tested independently.

actual_next_action.description: Used seven isolated local browser contexts: desktop and phone unknown-consent grant/deny/later, plus storage-denied. Normal clicks/taps operate the shared consent choices on title; title/help/pause/result preserve inactive board and expected Escape/Portal behavior. All external requests blocked.

final_root_cause: Native game dialog top-layer modality conflicted with unchanged document-level consent controls; fixed within Game020 UI, without common Analytics modifications.
